rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for presenting an award or prize to someone.

example.english: The school will award the prize to the student with the best results next week.
example.traditional: 學校下星期會頒獎畀成績最好嗰位同學。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 baan1 zoeng2 bei2 sing4 zik1 zeoi3 hou2 go2 wai2 tung4 hok6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken noun for a prize or award when the exact form is not important.

example.english: I got an award in this competition.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 lo2 zo2 go3 zoeng2

rows.note: Use this when the award is specifically a medal.

example.english: They won a medal award in the swimming competition.
example.traditional: 佢喺游水比賽贏咗塊獎牌。
example.jyutping: heoi5 hai2 jau4 seoi2 bei2 coi3 jeng4 zo2 faai3 zoeng2 paai4

rows.note: Use this when the award is specifically a trophy or cup.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ling1 zoeng2 bui1 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1
